messages.intro.title: Your image. Your avatar.
messages.intro.description: Turn any supported image into a {extension} file for your PS4 / PS5. All the right sizes, packaged in one click.
messages.steps.label: Conversion steps
messages.upload.heading: 01 / SOURCE IMAGES
messages.upload.formats: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, HEIC & more
messages.preview.heading: 02 / AVATAR PREVIEWS
messages.progress.label: Conversion progress
messages.about.privacy: {lock}100% in your browser. Your images never leave your device.
messages.about.formatDetails: A ZIP archive containing avatar.png, picture.png, eight DXT5 DDS images, and online.json. this page does not install avatars or modify your console.
messages.about.formats: Animated images use the first frame. Formats depend on ImageMagick support; unsupported or damaged files show an error. The conversion engine loads locally with the page.
messages.about.sourceDetails: You can find high-quality avatars to convert at the following websites:
messages.about.transfer: Once you have generated your {extension} file, transfer it to your console via FTP or USB. You can apply it using one of the following methods:
messages.about.explorerOpen: Navigate to the file location using {ps4} (or {ps5}).
messages.about.explorerApply: Simply press the {cross} button on the {extension} file to apply it.
messages.about.changerMove: Move the {extension} file to the following path on your console: {path}
messages.about.changerApply: Select and apply the image from within the application.
